## 8c3ccd709c5f

**Reproduced defect — validator and advertised controls are not trustworthy.** For
generator SHA-256 `d80c02ed329733120357ea3390cce06d4730ea2e0c33f91bee8cc70a56542e3c`,
`self_check([[0]*12 for _ in range(12)])` returns `[]`, even though the declared
legal domain requires marker colors and exactly one contained target. An exact call
requesting `grid_h=22`, `grid_w=24`, `orientation=h`, and `n_decoys=3` at easy
produced a 12×14 grid; an unknown axis was silently accepted. The official override
stage failed and reported more than 66,000 repeated findings. Evidence:
`checks/audit/audit_probe.json` and `checks/audit-8c3-override/`.

I checked the generator source, canonical marker layout/rule, blank and overridden
instances, and unknown-key behavior. I did not modify this audit target. The core
semantic construction appears compatible with the selected Racket rule, but the
current validator cannot certify it and the advertised exact control surface is
materially false.
